verdict.line: You lose trades level 1-8 to Parrrley poke and his solo-kill pressure, but you win extended skirmishes once Counter Strike and Trinity Force come online.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's passive Grog-Soaked Blade puts a leveling magic-damage poison on every auto he lands, and Q (Parrrley) is a 625-range pistol shot on a 5s cooldown that lets him apply that poison from outside your attack range. Jax has no ranged answer to this, so every uncontested trade before you can close distance bleeds you for free. The matchup swings the moment you're in melee range with E (Counter Strike) up, because that's the one tool in your kit that turns his follow-up autos into whiffs.

theirWindow.when: Parrrley (Q) is off cooldown and you approach
theirWindow.what: He pokes you for free at 625 range with no risk, and the Grog-Soaked Blade poison from that hit ticks harder every level. Don't walk up for a last hit into an unspent Q.

yourWindow.what: His only ranged tool is now locked for 5 seconds. Use Q (Leap Strike) to close the gap immediately and hold E (Counter Strike) for his retaliating autos so they whiff into the dodge window before the stun lands.

start.why: 47.6% win rate over 1333 games. The flat damage reduction on harass and the regen directly counter the chip from Parrrley and the Grog-Soaked Blade poison you'll eat while closing distance.

boots.why: 47.2% win rate, 70.8% pick rate. Gangplank's damage in this lane comes from repeated autos and Parrrley; Steelcaps cut the physical portion of that chip every time he lands a hit.

core.why: First piece of the highest-winning path (52.8% over 248 games); the damage and tempo spike is what finally lets you punish him once you're in range.
Second item on that same 52.8% path, rewards the all-in you take right after his Remove Scurvy or Parrrley go on cooldown.
Closes out the top-performing build; lets you commit to a Counter Strike engage without dying to his follow-up damage if the trade goes long.

situational.when: the lane turns into a prolonged poke war and you need to bleed through his chip rather than burst him down
he's stacking health and Remove Scurvy's heal is making him hard to finish once you land an all-in
you're swapping boots and need the magic resist against the Grog-Soaked Blade poison stacking up over a long game

runes.keystoneWhy: Jax wins this matchup by forcing extended melee duels once he's closed the gap, and Lethal Tempo's ramping attack speed feeds directly into R (Relentless Assault)'s own attack-speed stacking, making those duels snowball faster than his poke can punish you.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the better-performing combo here at 47.6% versus Flash+Ignite's 46.4%, and it plays to the actual shape of this lane: you're behind in solo-kill potential early, so resetting to lane after a shove and scaling into your Trinity Force timing matters more than forcing an early kill you're not favored to get.

playing.title: Punish only after Parrrley is spent
playing.detail: Approach to trade the instant he fires Q (Parrrley), not before. Walking into an unspent Parrrley just gives him free poison damage at zero risk.

playing.title: Don't contest CS into his auto range
playing.detail: Every auto he lands applies Grog-Soaked Blade's poison, which scales with his level. Let minions soak hits you'd otherwise take walking up for last hits.

playing.title: Hold Counter Strike for his auto string, not pre-emptively
playing.detail: E (Counter Strike) only dodges basic attacks, so firing it before he commits to autos wastes the 18/16/14/12/10s cooldown. Wait until he's actually swinging.

playing.title: Expect a weak Leap Strike most of the game
playing.detail: The standard skill order (EQWWWRWEWEREEQQ) maxes W and E long before Q, so Leap Strike sits near its 17s/14s cooldown through most of the laning phase. Don't plan trades around a gap-close that isn't there yet.

playing.title: Weave Empower on every cooldown
playing.detail: W (Empower) cycles down to 3s at max rank; use it on cooldown in short trades since you won't get long extended fights against his poke early.

playing.title: All-in the moment Remove Scurvy is down
playing.detail: W (Remove Scurvy) clears CC and heals him on a 22-18s cooldown. If you see him burn it, your next E (Counter Strike) stun sticks with no cleanse available.

playing.title: Play the long game and respect his ult's range
playing.detail: This lane favors him early, so lean on Jax's late scaling instead of forcing early aggression. When split pushing after laning phase, remember Cannon Barrage has unlimited range and slows, so don't stand still in a predictable spot once his 120s+ cooldown is back up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are pulled from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Gangplank’s Powder Keg(E) placed inside brushes! Close in to deal damage when Powder Keg (E) is on cooldown!
